name: truffiere-backend
description: API Backend pour la gestion de truffière avec authentification JWT

scripts.docs: NODE_ENV=development node -e "require('./swagger'); const express = require('express'); const app = express(); const {swaggerUi, swaggerDocument, swaggerOptions} = require('./swagger'); app.use('/api/docs', swaggerUi.serve, swaggerUi.setup(swaggerDocument, swaggerOptions)); app.listen(3099, () => console.log('Swagger UI: http://localhost:3099/api/docs'));"
